props.title: Your website already wrote your ==first posts==.
props.subtitle: Domain to Social turns any site into a ready-to-post social starter kit — bios, handles, and launch posts in minutes.

slides.notes: Hook: every founder stares at an empty profile on launch day. This tool fixes that. One sentence, then move on.

props.title: The ==blank profile== is where momentum dies.
props.body: Launch day demands a social presence — but bios, handles, and first posts all start from an empty box, while the website that explains everything just sits there.

slides.notes: Say it out loud: everyone has felt this. You spent weeks on the site, and then freeze for an hour on a 160-character bio.

props.title: Point it at a domain. Get the ==whole kit==.

items.title: Profile bios
items.body: Sized per platform — X, LinkedIn, GitHub — written from what your site actually says.

items.title: Handle shortlist
items.body: Available-feeling options derived from your name and positioning, ranked and ready to claim.

items.title: First posts
items.body: A set of launch-ready posts in your site's own voice — announce, explain, and invite.

slides.notes: Three deliverables, one input: a URL. Emphasize that everything is drafted from the site's real content, not templates.

props.title: From URL to ==post-ready== in four steps.

items.title: Fetch
items.body: Point the tool at your domain — it pulls the live site.

items.title: Extract
items.body: It works out what the project is and who it's for.

items.title: Generate
items.body: Bios, handles, and platform-ready drafts come back as a kit.

items.title: Review & post
items.body: You approve every word — nothing goes out without your say-so.

slides.notes: Walk the four steps quickly, then slow down on step 4: the human stays in the loop. Drafts, not autopilot.

left.label: Without
left.title: Blank box
points: Bios and posts written from scratch
Momentum spent on boilerplate, not the product

right.label: With
right.title: Your landing page
points: Copy that's already been approved — by you
Drafts arrive at 80% right; you polish the last 20%

slides.notes: The core insight: the hard part of social copy is already done — it's your website. The tool just re-uses approved material.

tiles.title: Per-platform sizing
tiles.body: Bio length and tone matched to each network's limits and culture.

tiles.title: Voice-matched posts
tiles.body: First posts echo the language of your site, not a generic template.

tiles.title: Human-in-the-loop
tiles.body: Everything lands in a review queue — you post, it never does.

tiles.title: One command
tiles.body: A domain in, a starter kit out. No accounts, no configuration.

tiles.title: Open source
tiles.body: Read it, fork it, shape it — the whole pipeline is on GitHub.

slides.notes: Pick two or three tiles to talk to — per-platform sizing and human-in-the-loop are the differentiators. Don't read every tile.
